synopsis: ALDUS is a 2021 lidar dust model that represents dust as spherical, homogeneous particles [f4654, f7828]. Published as arXiv 2105.04193, it was validated by reproducing a controlled experiment in the PROSIVIC simulator [f7828]. However, whether it reports a numeric error was not confirmed, leaving a gap in the quantitative validation evidence described by the corpus [f7829].

relations.note: Adds the dust-particle modeling assumption to the model’s publication and validation description.
Qualifies reported validation: numeric error reporting remains unconfirmed.
